description: This file contains the core processing pipeline for a logo replacement backend service, handling tasks such as rasterizing PDFs, detecting logos within images, overlaying logos onto images, and packaging results into ZIP files. It orchestrates the workflow using various utility modules and external services.

classes.name: JobState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the state of a job, e.g., RUNNING, COMPLETED.

classes.name: JobStore
classes.description: Service class for managing job-related data storage, status updates, and retrievals.

classes.name: VisionClient
classes.description: Client interface for vision detection services, such as logo detection in images.

classes.name: Detection
classes.description: Data structure representing detected logo regions within an image.

classes.name: PdfRasterizationConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for PDF rasterization process.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] _iter_image_files(root: Path)
methods.description: Generator yielding image files in a directory with specific image extensions.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] _iter_pdf_files(root: Path)
methods.description: Generator yielding PDF files in a directory.

methods.name: List[Path] _prepare_rasterized_inputs(drawings_dir: Path, work: Path)
methods.description: Prepares a list of images by including existing raster images and rasterizing PDFs in a directory.

methods.name: None process_job_pipeline(job_store: JobStore, job_id: str)
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the logo replacement process for a given job ID, including detection, overlay, and packaging.
